name: FrontierSWE v2 per-version control census (benchmark-coverage-frontierswe-v2-2026-10-10#P-007, AUTO-BAR-R-5-P-007@2)
summary: The published v2 control ledger was read through the production loader (loadFrontierSweTaskSet) and admitByFrontierSweControls at staging source 4385f55c4e. Result: 34 v2 tasks; 11 admitted, 8 quarantined, 15 GPU/external tasks pending and failing closed. Every CPU-runnable task has controls. Possible follow-up: notebook-compression and snooker-prediction scored gold=0 although the solve exited 0, which may be a verifier fault. They stay quarantined until a re-run proves otherwise.

admitted.rule: gold=1 (graderStatus passed), empty=0, both rows pinned to the task's corpusCommit + dockerImage, declared network verified

assertions.evidence: 34 v2 corpus tasks from loadFrontierSweTaskSet('frontier-swe-v2'); admitted=11, quarantined=8, pending=15; each task has exactly one status
all 19 CPU-runnable tasks (no GPU, no external service) carry control rows; 0 CPU tasks pending
all 11 admitted tasks have gold score 1 (graderStatus passed) and empty score 0, and both rows match the task's corpusCommit and dockerImage pins
all 8 excluded tasks with control rows name their exclusion reasons: gold-below-full x4, empty-above-zero x2, no-gold-control x2
the 15 tasks with no control rows are recorded as pending, each with its GPU/external-service reason, and none is admitted to a scored set
all 36 ledger rows carry networkPolicy {declaredMode:allowlist, agentNetworkMode:none} from the network-qualified r2 rerun; the published ledger has no historical open-egress row
with control gating, loadFrontierSweTaskSet('frontier-swe-v2-cpu') returns exactly the 11 admitted tasks
